answer: Pay only identities holding recent opal credits, earned in an oasis where jobs are posted openly. An opal is a non-transferable credit minted when a requester accepts work as useful, and opals wash out like a tide: each epoch an identity loses a third of its credits, so standing must be re-earned, never stockpiled. An honest agent stays topped up with one real job a week, nearly free. A farmer with 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 accepted jobs every epoch, one stream per fake; rings are caught when a fake's acceptances all come from one cluster, voiding its opals.
